'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Würzburg stabbing]]
**Three people are killed and seven others are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack in [[Würzburg]], [[Bavaria]], [[Germany]]. A [[Somalis in Germany|Somali]] man is arrested after being shot by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57618354 (BBC News)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Fifteen [[Germany|German]] [[United Nations]] peacekeepers are injured in a [[car bomb]] attack at their base in [[Tarkint]], [[Gao Region|Gao]], [[Mali]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/25/several-un-peacekeepers-wounded-in-mali-bomb-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**Three [[Doctors Without Borders]] staff are found dead near their vehicle in [[Tigray Region|Tigray]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.doctorswithoutborders.org/what-we-do/news-stories/news/ethiopia-three-msf-staff-killed-attack (MSF)]
**The [[United States Agency for International Development]] announces it estimates as many as 900,000 in the Tigray Region are facing a [[Anthropogenic hazard|man-made]] [[famine]], corroborating months-long reports from citizens and international observers that the [[Ethiopian National Defense Force|Ethiopian Army]] have been obstructing and looting farmers. [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] continues to claim there is "no hunger" in Tigray. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/turkeys-erdogan-takes-first-step-in-crazy-canal-project/ar-AALtrDH?ocid=BingNews (Associated Press on MSN)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A helicopter carrying [[President of Colombia|Colombian President]] [[Iván Duque Márquez]] and several [[government of Colombia|government]] ministers, including Defense Minister [[Diego Molano Aponte]], is struck by several bullets while flying to [[Cúcuta]]. Nobody was injured in the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/helicopter-carrying-colombias-president-duque-struck-by-bullets-attack-2021-06-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[China|Chinese]] automobile company [[Geely]], the current owners of the [[Volvo Cars]] brand, withdraws its application to open a second listing on the [[Shanghai Stock Exchange]]'s [[Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market|STAR Market]]. [https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3138823/chinese-carmaker-geely-scraps-us3-billion-secondary-listing-shanghais (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Zhecheng school fire]]
**At least 18 people are killed and 16 others are injured in a fire at a [[martial arts]] school in [[Zhecheng County|Zhecheng]], [[Henan]], [[China]]. Most of the victims are pupils between the ages of seven and sixteen years old. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-57607869 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]]i [[Government of Bangladesh|authorities]] announces that the country will enter a total [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] on 28 June as the number of [[COVID-19]] cases increases dramatically. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2021/06/25/bangladesh-goes-into-nationwide-hard-lockdown-from-june-28 (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] surpasses 500 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50881190/cambodia-covid-death-total-crosses-500-mark-with-115-deaths-reported-in-6-days/ (Khmer Times)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] receives his first dose of the Iranian-made [[COVID-19 vaccine]] [[COVIran Barakat]]. Khamenei says that he would not have received a foreign vaccine and says that receiving an Iranian-made vaccine was a "national pride". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/6/25/irans-supreme-leader-receives-local-covid-vaccine (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] reimposes the use of [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask]]s in indoor settings as the country reports a small increase in the number of cases, mostly linked to the [[Delta variant]] which was first reported in India. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-s-covid-czar-warns-of-rising-infections-but-not-yet-a-fourth-wave-1.9939962 (Haaretz)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] restricts entry into the capital [[Tashkent]] amidst a rise of cases in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/uzbekistan-restricts-entry-capital-after-covid-19-cases-jump-2021-06-25/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
***[[Tunisia]]n [[Prime Minister of Tunisia|Prime Minister]] [[Hichem Mechichi]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/06/25/us-tunisia-coronavirus-government (Euronews)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Secretary of State for Health and Social Care|Health Secretary]] [[Matt Hancock]] admits and apologizes for breaking COVID-19 [[social distancing]] rules in response to a reported [[affair]] with his [[Personal assistant|aide]] Gina Coladangelo that was reported by the ''[[The Sun (United Kingdom)|The Sun]]''. The opposition [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] calls for Hancock's immediate resignation or termination, calling his position "untenable". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-57612441 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ryanair Flight 4978]]
**[[Belarus]]ian opposition activist [[Roman Protasevich]] is moved to [[house arrest]] after spending a month in prison. Opposition leader [[Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya]] welcomes the news but says that Protasevich is still considered a "[[hostage]]". [https://www.dw.com/en/belarus-plane-hijack-journalist-moved-to-house-arrest/a-58042460 (DW)]
*[[Trial of Derek Chauvin]]
**Former [[Minneapolis]] police officer [[Derek Chauvin]] is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to 22 and a half years in prison for the [[murder of George Floyd]] in May 2020. During the sentencing, Chauvin expressed condolences to Floyd's family. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/06/25/derek-chauvin-sentencing-for-murder-of-george-floyd.html (CNBC)]
*[[Public Safety Canada|Canadian Public Safety Minister]] [[Bill Blair (politician)|Bill Blair]] announces that American [[American militia movement|militia]] group [[Three Percenters]], British [[Neo-Nazism|Neo-Nazi]] group Aryan Strikeforce, the [[Islamic State's Central Africa Province|Congolese division of ISIL]], and American neo-Nazi [[James Mason (neo-Nazi)|James Mason]] have been added to [[Organizations designated as terrorist by Canada|Canada's list of terror groups]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/terrorist-list-three-percenters-1.6079984 (CBC)]
*The [[National Penitentiary Institute (Peru)|National Penitentiary Institute]] and [[Peruvian Navy]] opens an investigation into former [[Alberto Fujimori]] adviser [[Vladimiro Montesinos]] after he allegedly made phone calls to the [[National Jury of Elections]] from the [[Callao]] naval base, where he is being held. [https://andina.pe/Ingles/noticia-peru-prosecutors-office-to-launch-investigation-into-vladimiro-montesinos-audios-850778.aspx (Andina)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Gibraltar abortion referendum]]
**[[Gibraltar]] votes 62% in favour of legalizing [[abortion]]. Under the new proposed amendment to the criminal law bill, pregnancies can be terminated by a registered physician within the first 12 weeks, while abortions would be permitted at a later stage of the pregnancy under a "narrow set of circumstances". [https://www.reuters.com/world/gibraltar-approves-easing-strict-abortion-law-referendum-2021-06-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian opposition]] figure [[Ilya Yashin]] is barred from the next elections after being ruled as an "[[extremist]]". Yashin says that this is likely because of his support for jailed [[government of Russia|government]] critic [[Alexei Navalny]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-opposition-figure-says-election-bid-blocked-over-navalny-support-2021-06-25/ (Reuters)]
*Thousands of [[Palestinians]] attend the funeral of [[Palestinian National Authority|government]] critic Nizar Banat in [[Hebron]]. Many in attendance reiterate their calls for [[President of the State of Palestine|President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]]'s [[resignation]] for the role his [[Palestinian National Security Forces|security forces]] played in Banat's death. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1883476/middle-east (''Arab News'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese archaeology|Chinese archaeologists]] report in the [[scientific journal|journal]] ''The Innovation'' that a skull discovered in [[Harbin]] in 1933 by a [[Manchukuo National Railway]] bridge, known as ''[[Homo longi]]'' or "Dragon Man", belongs to a previously undiscovered species of [[Homo|early human]]s dating back 146,000 years ago. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-57432104 (BBC News)]
